evals.name: review-and-fix-flagged-frames-only
evals.prompt: Studio's request: You are Studio's team on task t1, working on Serum launch (pages/serum-launch). Review and fix only these frames, which Studio's checks flagged: - pages/serum-launch instagram-story (b): Text "Brighter skin in two weeks of daily use" is clipped by its box. In this task metamorfiles_ask_user takes the recommended option.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer, then the copywriter or designer, fix only the story frame of variant b, reporting each step, and the summary is one or two plain sentences.
assertions: Calls metamorfiles_team_update with task t1 before changing any file
Claims only frames of pages/serum-launch instagram-story variant b while working
Changes no file for other variants or formats
Every metamorfiles_team_update line is under eight words and names no file or tool
Renders the changed frame again and leaves no check error
Ends each role with status done
The final summary has no control panel link, hex value or pixel size

evals.name: copy-choice-asked-in-chat
evals.prompt: Studio's request: You are Studio's team on task t2, working on Serum launch (pages/serum-launch). The user asked: Make the headline punchier. Mode: Chat.
evals.expected_output: The copywriter offers two or three headline angles with metamorfiles_ask_user, one recommended, waits for the answer, writes it within maxLength, and the designer re-fits the layout.
assertions: Calls metamorfiles_ask_user with 2 to 4 options and exactly one recommended
Options differ in angle, not only in wording
Keeps calling with waitFor while the answer is waiting
The chosen headline fits the variable's maxLength
Introduces no claim, number or price that isn't in the brand or the page

evals.name: new-image-in-auto
evals.prompt: Studio's request: You are Studio's team on task t3, working on launch-post (templates/launch-post). The user asked: The photo feels cold, make it warmer. Mode: Auto.
evals.expected_output: The image maker writes a prompt from the variable's instruction and the Imagery section, generates without a model, places it, checks every format's crop, and says in the summary what was chosen for the user.
assertions: The prompt asks for no text or logo in the image
Renders every format that shows the image
The summary says which option was chosen in Auto

evals.name: user-message-mid-task
evals.prompt: Studio's request: You are Studio's team on task t4, working on Serum launch (pages/serum-launch). The user asked: Tighten the spacing on the stories. (During the task, a metamorfiles_team_update result says: The user said: "Leave variant A as it is.")
evals.expected_output: After the update returns the user's message, the team stops changing variant A and continues on the rest.
assertions: Makes no change to variant A after the user's message arrives
Mentions in the thread or summary that variant A was left as it is
